correctness.rationale: Global simplex maxima are interior; derivative and curvature conditions reduce every maximizing candidate to equality or one higher coordinate and all others equal. A strictly convex ratio has exactly one positive stock crossing for each unequal fraction; its bijective exponential-sum parametrization yields the exact threshold and all boundaries. For two sites hyperbolic monotonicity proves the unique continuous branch at stock 4. For at least three, the negative first-order slope of the crossing-stock function at zero forces an attained threshold below 2m, while strict concavity near stock 2 proves it is above 2. Differentiated stationarity proves the high-stock limit. All claims have analytic proofs in RESULT.md; the executable is supplementary diagnostics.

value.rationale: A complete natural optimization for identical spatially separate Ricker recruitment connects the well-motivated issue of spawner clustering to the otherwise invisible m=2 vs m>=3 qualitative transition. The exact threshold and positive jump distinguish global from local concavity, while the unbounded ratio against individual-success equality gives a substantive model-level efficiency phenomenon. Significance is limited to the stated idealized deterministic ecological model.
